title: Track persistence contract and in-memory CAS foundation
purpose: Establish the first dedicated persistence boundary for canonical SeshTrack records before D1, HTTP, Studio track management, or project-track lifecycle orchestration is introduced.
repositoryCapabilities: track collection read by canonical SeshMusicProjectId
boundaries: Track persistence does not create or mutate project.trackIds.
Track persistence does not attach or detach audio assets from a project.
Track persistence does not move, copy, delete, or rewrite audio bytes.
Track persistence does not grant project ownership or collaborator authority.
Track persistence does not create public audio authority.
Track persistence does not establish copyright, publishing, master, management, royalty, licensing, or ownership rights.
D1 persistence remains a later explicit slice.
HTTP and Studio UI remain later explicit slices.
